summary: Honest multi-level evaluation of VAADA NLU pipeline

baseline_tfidf_lr.note: High synthetic F1 expected - same distribution. Low external F1 shows distribution shift from LLM-generated to real human text.

finetuned_gemma3_1b.note: Lower than baseline on synthetic but more robust generative model.

real_world_validation.method: Real Razorpay API calls - actual payment links generated
real_world_validation.note: Most credible metric - real conversations real API

recovery_predictor_v2.note: Previous F1=1.0 was label leakage. This version excludes intent from features.

honest_conclusion: VAADA works on synthetic Hinglish with high accuracy. Real Hinglish shows distribution shift - this is expected and honest. Fine-tuned Gemma-3-1B and real data collection are the path to production-grade performance.
